purpose: Small real-data TDD fixture extracted from the Torrevieja canonical stops and two contiguous A2 direction slices.

transformations.description: Assigns stable physical tv-place identifiers from the conservative torrevieja-stop-node-to-stop-place-v1 registry. Exact-name, close, complementary-direction pairs may share a StopPlace; every other mapped StopNode remains a singleton. Route and pattern assets are unchanged.

warnings: StopPlace grouping does not create passenger route edges, reverse edges, or vehicle-cycle handoff edges. In particular, tv-stop-0207 and tv-stop-0209 share a physical StopPlace while remaining distinct graph vertices.
